s.note: Ray's Iowa cornfield around the diamond
s.how: Grill 4 husked corn cobs over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with the zest of 1 lime. Brush the hot cobs all over with the mayonnaise, then roll in 80g finely crumbled feta. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp chilli powder and chopped coriander and serve with lime wedges.

s.note: Ray and Terence Mann at Fenway Park
s.how: Slice 1 red and 1 green capsicum and 2 onions and fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until soft and sweet, seasoning with salt and a pinch of oregano. Grill 4 Italian sausages for 12 minutes, turning, then split lengthways. Toast 4 long rolls. Fill with sausage, pile on the peppers and onions and finish with wholegrain or spicy brown mustard.

m.note: dinner on the Kinsellas' Iowa farm
m.how: Cut 600g pork fillet into 4 pieces and pound each to 5mm thin and wider than the bun. Dust in 60g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g crushed crackers mixed with panko. Shallow fry at 180C for 3 minutes a side until golden. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp vinegar. Serve in 4 soft buns with mustard, mayo, pickles and sliced onion and the slaw on the side.

w.note: Is this heaven? No, it's Iowa
w.how: Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 100g caster sugar, 2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp cornflour and the juice of half a lemon. Line a 23cm pie dish with 1 sheet shortcrust pastry and fill. Cover with a second sheet, crimp and cut slits. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes, then 180C for 35 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream and salted caramel sauce.

d.note: Shoeless Joe stepping out of the corn
d.how: Simmer 150g caster sugar with 150ml water until dissolved and cool. Blend 250g hulled strawberries with the syrup and strain. Stir in the juice of 6 lemons and 700ml cold water. Chill for 30 minutes. Pour over ice into 4 tall glasses and garnish with sliced strawberries, lemon wheels and mint.
